text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black thick acetate rectangular eyeglasses with clear transparent optical lenses, full frame and both temples visible.
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic isolated eyewear product on pure white background, soft studio lighting, portrait 2:3. Extract ONLY the black thick rectangular eyeglasses worn by the RIGHT person in this reference. Clear transparent optical lenses, NOT sunglasses. Entire frame with both temples visible in three-quarter view. No person, face, skin, mannequin, other objects, labels or watermark.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
